senses.sense_definition: Guidance, protection, sponsorship, or support, especially when provided by an influential person or organization.

examples.text: The medical conference was organized under the <w>aegis</w> of the World Health Organization.
Young scientists carried out their research safely under the protective <w>aegis</w> of the university.

senses.sense_definition: A mythological shield or defensive garment associated with Zeus and Athena, symbolizing divine protection and authority.

examples.text: Athena raised the divine <w>aegis</w> to shield the ancient warriors in battle.
Ancient statues depict the goddess wearing the <w>aegis</w> adorned with serpents.

senses.sense_definition: Autonomous Exploration for Gathering Increased Science, an autonomous exploration software system.

examples.text: NASA scientists implemented <w>AEGIS</w> on the Mars rover to automate rock sampling.
The latest robotic mission relied on <w>AEGIS</w> to select promising geological targets.
